Class SnapshotTelemetryExtractor

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.SnapshotTelemetryExtractor
public final class SnapshotTelemetryExtractor extends Object
Post-hoc telemetry extractor operating directly on serialized world snapshots (snapshot_tick_*.bin.gz) or in-memory H3Cell state frames.

Uses the exact same TelemetryAstCompiler / CompiledTelemetryPlan DAG engine as live simulation ticks, guaranteeing 100% mathematical equivalence without re-executing simulation physics or maintaining duplicate formula logic.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

      public static TelemetryEvaluationResult extractFromCells(List<H3Cell> cells, TelemetrySubscription subscription, long tick, long year)
      Evaluates an explicit TelemetrySubscription directly over a cellular snapshot.
      Parameters:
      cells - cellular world snapshot

    • extractFromCells

      public static TelemetryEvaluationResult extractFromCells(List<H3Cell> cells, CompiledTelemetryPlan plan, long tick, long year, long initialPopulation, double t0Co2Ppm, double elapsedYears)
      Evaluates a pre-compiled CompiledTelemetryPlan directly over a cellular snapshot, bypassing H3 ring-1 neighbor graph allocation for maximum throughput.
      Parameters:
      cells - cellular world snapshot
      plan - pre-compiled DAG telemetry plan
      tick - snapshot tick index
      year - snapshot calendar year
      initialPopulation - optional initial scenario population $N_0$ ($\le 0$ falls back gracefully)
      t0Co2Ppm - initial atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ baseline in ppm
      elapsedYears - elapsed years since scenario start
      Returns:
      immutable evaluated telemetry result

    • extractFromSnapshotFile

      public static TelemetryEvaluationResult extractFromSnapshotFile(Path snapshotFile, TelemetrySubscription subscription, long tick, long year) throws IOException
      Loads a persisted compressed cellular snapshot from disk and extracts all subscribed 1D scalar metrics and 2D spatial raster slices/statistics.
      Parameters:
      snapshotFile - path to snapshot_tick_*.bin.gz
      subscription - desired metrics and spatial queries
      tick - snapshot tick index
      year - snapshot calendar year
      Returns:
      immutable telemetry evaluation result
      Throws:
      IOException - if the snapshot archive cannot be read or decoded

    • extractTimeline

      public static NavigableMap<Long, TelemetryEvaluationResult> extractTimeline(SimulationHistoryCoordinator historyManager, TelemetrySubscription subscription, long startYear, double ticksPerYear)
      Streams every chronological world snapshot stored in SimulationHistoryCoordinator through a single compiled CompiledTelemetryPlan, returning an ordered timeline of extracted results without re-running the simulation engine.
      Parameters:
      historyManager - snapshot repository containing persisted H3Cell frames
      subscription - explicit telemetry and spatial subscription
      startYear - scenario start year
      ticksPerYear - ticks elapsed per simulated calendar year ($\ge 1$)
      Returns:
      chronologically ordered map of tick -> TelemetryEvaluationResult
